# refactor: move GitHub code out of integrations into the layered owners

One slice of the application-boundaries refactor. **Treat this request as self-contained**: everything needed is below and in `docs/specs/application-boundaries.md`. Do not assume access to the parent issue or its siblings.

Lands after the issue that introduces `src/composition`, and builds on it. The application-API
issue lands after this one.

## What

The GitHub issue command works exactly as before. Its code sits in the same layers as the rest of
jig, and the separate integrations folder is gone.

## Why

The GitHub feature groups command handling, orchestration, rules, contracts and external
operations in one folder that depends on both the command line and the application. The rest of jig
groups code by responsibility. Organizing GitHub the same way gives it the same owners and
dependency directions as everything else.

## Context — read this first

jig is a TypeScript CLI that turns a markdown request into planned slices, has agents implement and
review each one in a sandbox, and lands them on one run branch. Source owners under `src/`:
`domain` (business rules), `ports` (external capability contracts), `config` (settings schemas and
policy), `flow`/`steps` (workflow execution), `prompts`, `observers` (events and reporting),
`adapters` (Git, GitHub, files, containers, terminal, logging), `app` (use cases) and `cli` (commands).
Specs sit beside the code they cover (`foo.ts` → `foo.spec.ts`). Before editing, read `AGENTS.md`,
the house rules in `.claude/rules/` that cover the files you change, and `docs/architecture.html`.

This issue implements one part of the design in `docs/specs/application-boundaries.md`. That file is
in the repository; read the sections named below. Where this issue and the spec disagree, follow
the spec and say so in the PR.

## Don't undo these

- Agents run unattended only inside the sandbox. Never add an agent call that runs on the host.
- Credentials never land in a file jig writes, a log line or the image. The one exception:
  `jig init` saves a credential to `.jig/.env` (owner-only, git-ignored) after the operator agrees.
- Nothing touches the target repository's tracked files outside the run's worktree.
- Keep commands, flags, defaults, help, error tags and messages, exit codes, configuration
  precedence and recovery behavior unchanged unless this issue says otherwise.
- Expected failures are `Result` values; bugs panic. jig never throws.
- Keep dependency policy in `.dependency-cruiser.mjs` and `scripts/check-dependencies.mjs`, with
  fixtures in `scripts/check-dependencies.spec.ts`. Do not write another source scanner.
- No release tags and no version bumps; `main` publishes on its own.
- If you change where something lives, update `docs/architecture.html`, `docs/workflow-ownership.md`
  and the code map in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and any guide that names a moved path. Describe current
  behavior in the present tense.

## Target

Spec section: "Redistribute GitHub functionality".

Split mixed files by responsibility; do not assign an owner from the filename alone.

| Current (`src/integrations/github/`) | Destination |
| --- | --- |
| `command.ts`: registration, schemas, terminal descriptions | `cli` |
| `implement-issue.ts`: accepted request and publication coordination | `app` |
| `github-port.ts` and the publication/store capabilities app actually needs | `ports` |
| `octokit-github.ts` | `adapters/github` |
| `repository-identity.ts`, `run-branch-publication.ts`: discovery, remote refs, push, ancestry | the Git adapters |
| `orchestration-store.ts`: receipts and leases | a persistence adapter |
| `orchestration-state.ts`: pure acceptance, receipt, lease and refusal transitions | `domain` |
| `request-snapshot.ts`, `findings-comment.ts`: content construction | the application/presentation policy that owns it, using domain data |
| `errors.ts` | owners assigned the same way as by the error-ownership rules |

- `orchestration-store.ts` imports `app/report-cleanup.ts`. Moving it unchanged would make an
  adapter depend on app. Either app owns publication lifetime through a narrow capability, or the
  adapter owns its own self-contained cleanup.
- Domain must not import the GitHub port just to get a repository identity type. Put the shared
  identity in domain and keep request/response details in the port.
- GitHub issue implementation runs a jig run through the same application code as `jig run`.
  It supplies the accepted request, run identity, required stores and publication choice. It does
  not duplicate start/resume, locking, sandbox preparation or run cleanup.
- Preserve lease renewal, recovery markers, default-branch checks, deferred publication, required
  stores, protected-path refusal, ready/draft PR selection, and idempotent comments and PRs.
- Move specs with their subjects. Delete `src/integrations` with no forwarding modules.
- Lint: remove `integrations` from `productionModules` and the `github-is-isolated` rule in
  `.dependency-cruiser.mjs`. Remove `githubOnlyInIntegration` and the related entries in
  `eslint.config.js`, and reconcile overlapping flat-config entries so a later entry does not
  silently drop a restriction. Delete the custom scanner `src/boundary.spec.ts`. Add rules that
  adapters cannot import `app`, `flow`, `steps`, `cli` or `composition`, extending the existing
  `adapters-do-not-import-flow` rule rather than duplicating it. Add a fixture showing that a new
  file under `src/integrations/` fails ownership.
- Docs: `docs/workflow-ownership.md` still lists `integrations`; update it and
  `docs/architecture.html`.

## Done when

- [ ] `src/integrations` and `src/boundary.spec.ts` no longer exist, and
      `grep -rn integrations src .dependency-cruiser.mjs eslint.config.js scripts` finds nothing
      except the fixture that proves rejection.
- [ ] GitHub behavior tests still exercise real orchestration through ports and fakes, with
      regression tests for anything the split exposed.
- [ ] The built executable's `github implement --help` works.
- [ ] The verification below passes.

## Verification

From the repository root using the pinned Node version (`volta` in `package.json`):

```sh
npm run lint:dependencies
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm run format:check
npm run validate -- --skip test:mutation
```

No check may start an agent on the host or publish to GitHub. In the PR, state which owner each
moved concept now belongs to and why.


Source: https://github.com/ygrishajev/jig/issues/47

context.repoSummary:
The TypeScript ESM CLI already starts in src/composition/main.ts, whose buildJigCli registers the GitHub command through transitional dependency exceptions. Container construction remains in src/app/container.ts; the broader application-API refactor is subsequent work. docs/specs/application-boundaries.md defines the target ownership and error rules.

src/integrations/github currently mixes Commander registration, environment parsing, Octokit construction, orchestration, Git operations, persistence, pure transitions and content formatting. implementIssue already delegates execution to app/run-jig.ts with an accepted snapshot, stable run ID, merge:false, deferred code publication and required git-remote storage. Preserve that shared lifecycle. OrchestrationStore persists receipts and publication leases through adapters/git/remote-ref.ts, but imports app/report-cleanup.ts; this dependency must be resolved when extracting the persistence adapter. orchestration-state.ts imports RepositoryIdentity from github-port.ts, so shared identity must move into domain. Split errors.ts by condition ownership and expose narrow GitHub, publication and store capabilities through ports.

Move command/presentation into cli, coordination/content policy into app, pure transitions into domain, contracts into ports, Octokit into adapters/github, and Git/persistence operations into appropriate adapters. Colocated specs already cover real orchestration with fake GitHub/agents and temporary Git repositories, including snapshot reuse, required remote state, lease exclusion, recovery after lost receipts, workflow-path refusal, deferred publication, ready/draft PRs and idempotent findings/comments.

Dependency policy lives in .dependency-cruiser.mjs and scripts/check-dependencies.mjs with fixtures in scripts/check-dependencies.spec.ts. Remove integrations ownership and transitional exceptions, extend adapter restrictions, and add rejected-owner coverage. In this checkout src/boundary.spec.ts, github-is-isolated and githubOnlyInIntegration are already absent. Update architecture.html, workflow-ownership.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and moved-path references. Package scripts provide the requested validation; Volta pins Node 26.13.0. Verify built dist/composition/main.js github implement --help without live agents or GitHub publication.
